[P2] Reject trailing content in JSON previews

`collectStreamingPreview` stops after the first top-level object, and this return never verifies EOF. Consequently, a value such as `{"id":"1"}{"secret":"value"}` is accepted and publishes only the first object's preview even though it is not a valid JSON document, producing incomplete or misleading envelope metadata. When collection fully consumes the preview object, require the parser's next token to be null; preserve intentional early budget truncation and add a trailing-token test.
